Doc ID: RM-DOC-0113
Title: Rail authority adds capacity on the Ironway
Outlet: Freight & Ledger
Publication Date: 2025-04-02
Source Type: shipping_update
Event ID: EVT-A
Country: Brenmark; Corvenia; Dalmora
Sector: electronics
Reliability Tier: 2

The Ironway Rail Link operator has added night services and now expects to carry about 30 percent of diverted electronics freight for Brenmark through the second quarter.

Coastal feeders from Skarport add a little more, but forwarders say the combined alternatives will not exceed one third of the cargo that normally uses the canal.
